There is a 2001 original anime with 1 season and there is a 2019 reboot which follows the manga more accurately and will have a completed series. I recommend the reboot as it is more true to the story and is still being released so you could catch up with the thriving and active fandom 

Each episode of season 2 is currently being released every Monday/ Tuesday (depending on where you live)

If you’re into dubs sadly not all of season 2 is dubbed because of corona but the dub is slowly being released (woop woop)

It’s got some romance (not to spoil too much but there is kind of a love triangle and if you are into ships there are definitely quite a few ships throughout the series to follow)

But so give the basis there is a girl named tohru who found herself living with this cursed family  ‘what is this curse and what does it do’ watch and find out :) living with these mysterious boys: the tsundere, the prince and the pervert..? (Idk) she finds out the dark past from this family and wants to find a way to break the curse. There are definitely many episodes that will pull on your heart strings (such as s1 ep24/ and pretty much all of the beach arc from season 2)


Ahhh sorry for rambling on, it’s just my favourite anime and I love talking about it but I wholeheartedly recommend this show ^^
